A fast new database engine

The team rewrote the storage layer around a log-structured design, which the authors say doubles sustained write throughput on commodity SSDs.

Benchmarks in the post compare the engine with two established systems on mixed read and write workloads, with latency percentiles reported.

  • Short
  • The compaction scheduler adapts to load, which keeps tail latency steady during bursts of writes.
